```{r Packages}
source(here::here("R", "paths.R"))
library(tidyverse)
library(yardstick)
library(vroom)
```

```{r Foundation losses in validation set}
eval_losses <- read_csv(out_path("foundation-models/foundation_models_eval_losses.csv")) %>%
  mutate(
    # Labelled by the parameter count of each architecture, counted from its config (the published
    # figure called these 100M / 300M / 500M; only the largest was close). 2026-Foundation-* are the
    # replications trained at the sizes the names claimed; they are a check, not a published panel.
    model = recode(model,
                   'model_256x1024' = '50M',
                   'model_512x2048' = '151M',
                   'model_512x2048-undiversified' = '151M Random Sample',
                   'model_1024x4096' = '487M',
                   'model_768x11' = '104M',
                   'model_1024x20' = '304M',
                   'model_1024x20-undiversified' = '304M Random Sample'),
    text_col = recode(text_col,
                      'junction' = 'CDR3',
                      'sequence' = 'Complete VDJ'),
    text_col = fct_rev(text_col)
  )

# Bootstrapped mean validation loss (1000 resamples) per model and input type
plot_eval_loss <- function(models) {
  eval_losses %>%
    filter(model %in% models) %>%
    mutate(model = factor(model, levels = models)) %>%
    group_by(model, text_col) %>%
    summarise(
      boot_mean = replicate(1000, mean(sample(loss, replace = TRUE))),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = model, y = boot_mean, fill = model)) +
    geom_boxplot(notch = T, outliers = F) +
    theme_linedraw(base_size = 14) +
    theme(aspect.ratio = 1,
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
          legend.position = "none") +
    facet_wrap(vars(text_col), scales = "free") +
    scale_fill_viridis_d() +
    labs(y = "Mean CE Loss", x = "")
}

set.seed(42)
plot_eval_loss(c('50M', '151M', '487M'))
ggsave(out_path("figures/fig2B_validation_loss_by_model_size.svg"))

# The same three models beside the 104M / 304M replications (trained with the same recipe for 23.5 h,
# against 24 h for the 50M/151M models and 48 h for the 487M one). Not a published panel: at a fixed
# time budget the deeper 304M model trains more slowly, so it does not beat the 151M one and size and
# shape are confounded. Skipped unless those checkpoints have been trained and evaluated.
if (all(c('104M', '304M') %in% eval_losses$model)) {
  set.seed(42)
  print(plot_eval_loss(c('50M', '104M', '151M', '304M', '487M')))
  ggsave(out_path("figures/foundation_validation_loss_published_vs_sized.svg"))
}
```
